recent_news.author: Diego Sandoval
recent_news.description: Mike Evans is planning to play in Week 1 as he continues to deal with a groin injury.
recent_news.impact: Evans' groin injury is being described as "minor" after missing back-to-back practices this week. The veteran's status should be monitored leading up to the opening week of the regular season.
recent_news.title: Mike Evans (groin) planning to play Week 1

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: Deshaun Watson and the Browns starters will not play in Thursday's preseason finale against the Patriots.
recent_news.impact: We will see Watson and the starters for Cleveland back on the field in Week 1 against the Jaguars.
recent_news.title: Deshaun Watson, starters will not play Thursday

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: James Conner is progressing from his foot injury, but he remains uncertain for Week 1.
recent_news.impact: Conner's role in the Cardinals backfield remains unclear following the offseason additions of Jeremiyah Love and Tyler Allgeier.
recent_news.title: James Conner (foot) progressing, uncertain for Week 1

recent_news.author: Leo Sells
recent_news.description: Josh Allen won't play in Thursday night's preseason finale against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
recent_news.impact: Allen saw some action earlier on in the preseason, but he is set to be sidelined for the team's final preseason game on Thursday night. He is fully healthy at this point and looks primed for another huge season from a fantasy perspective.
recent_news.title: Josh Allen won't play Thursday

recent_news.author: Leo Sells
recent_news.description: Ty Johnson (leg) didn't practice on Tuesday but has resumed running.
recent_news.impact: Johnson was technically a non-participant at Buffalo's practice on Tuesday, but he seems to be progressing well with his recovery and has resumed running. The team isn't certain whether or not he will be ready for Week 1 at this point, but his status doesn't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes.
recent_news.title: Ty Johnson (leg) progressing with recovery

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: The Steelers restructured DK Metcalf's contract.
recent_news.impact: The move creates nearly $18 million in cap space for Pittsburgh.
recent_news.title: DK Metcalf restructures contract with Steelers

recent_news.author: Garrett Ball
recent_news.description: Josh Jacobs has been charged with two misdemeanors following an incident in May. His initial court date is set for mid-November. The NFL is conducting its own investigation, and a suspension could soon follow.
recent_news.impact: It's important to remember that the NFL has the ability to either suspend Jacobs at the start of the season or wait until the legal process is over. If they wait, then Jacobs will likely not face suspension until next year. If not, we could be looking at a potential 6-8 game absence, though that is more of an educated guess at this point. For anyone taking Jacobs in drafts right now, Marshawn Lloyd is a must-have handcuff and is a great target for Zero-RB builds.
recent_news.title: Josh Jacobs charged with two misdemeanors stemming from May incident

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: Tua Tagovailoa will start Friday's preseason game against the Dolphins.
recent_news.impact: Tagovailoa will close out the preseason against his former team. Michael Penix Jr. will not play. The starter role for Week 1 remains up in the air.
recent_news.title: Tua Tagovailoa to start preseason finale Friday

recent_news.author: Leo Sells
recent_news.description: Justin Herbert and most of Los Angeles' starters will play in Thursday's preseason finale against the Los Angeles Rams.
recent_news.impact: HC Jim Harbaugh told reporters that Herbert and most of the team's starters are going to play in their final preseason game on Thursday night, with the exception of a few veterans. It remains unlikely that the starting unit will see more than a quarter or two of action, however.
recent_news.title: Justin Herbert, starters will play Thursday

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: The Bengals starters will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the Eagles.
recent_news.impact: We will see Joe Burrow and the starters for Cincinnati back on the field in Week 1 against the Bucs.
recent_news.title: Joe Burrow, Bengals starters will not play in preseason finale

recent_news.author: Garrett Ball
recent_news.description: Tutu Atwell has been traded to the Los Angeles Rams for Jarquez Hunter.
recent_news.impact: Either the Dolphins got a good enough look at Tutu to feel fine letting him go, or the Rams are bracing for a potential Puka Nacua suspension and wanted to bring in a familiar face. Or both could be true. Either way, it's not a good look for Atwell that he made himself expendable on a team desperate for receivers. However, it's about as favorable a spot as he could've landed on.
recent_news.title: Tutu Atwell traded to the Los Angeles Rams

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: Ja'Marr Chase is not practicing on Wednesday.
recent_news.impact: Chase appeared to have avoided a scary injury during Tuesday's practice. He was not wearing any protective equipment on the knee, which is notable.
recent_news.title: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) not practicing Wednesday

recent_news.author: Garrett Ball
recent_news.description: Devonta Smith (hamstring) is practicing fully on Monday for the first time in three weeks. He returned in a limited fashion recently, but he is back to fully participating.
recent_news.impact: It's great news for Smith as he works his way back from a hamstring injury. This should be the all the confidence boost fantasy managers needed to continue targeting him highly in drafts.
recent_news.title: DeVonta Smith practicing fully on Monday

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Isiah Pacheco is dealing with a back injury in addition to his MCL sprain.
recent_news.impact: Pacheco remains without a clear timetable to return. The Lions recently worked out Kareem Hunt.
recent_news.title: Isiah Pacheco dealing with back injury in addition to MCL sprain

recent_news.author: Garrett Ball
recent_news.description: Chris Olave was slow to get up after doing a deep route in practice, landing hard on his back. HC Kellen Moore said that the receiver had the wind knocked out of him, and when asked if there would be further tests or cause for concern, declined to answer.
recent_news.impact: It sounds like Olave should be fine. He shouldn't suffer any setbacks because of this unless the staff is hiding details. Draft Olave with confidence as the WR1 in an up and coming Saints offense.
recent_news.title: Chris Olave slow to get up Tuesday at practice

recent_news.author: Nate Miller
recent_news.description: Alec Pierce (ankle) was activated from the PUP list on Thursday.
recent_news.impact: Pierce has been rehabbing from surgery back in March. The big-play wideout will finally join the Colts at practice in hopes of being ready to go for Week 1. Pierce eclipsed 1,000 yards receiving for the first time in his career last season and has led the NFL in yards per catch each of the last two years.
recent_news.title: Alec Pierce (ankle) activated from PUP list

recent_news.author: Garrett Ball
recent_news.description: Calvin Austin III (knee) is out for the season with a torn ACL that he suffered during Tuesday's practice.
recent_news.impact: Austin was trying to find his way onto the field in a crowded Giants receiver room, and now finds himself out for the season. He was in a contract year, so this is a big blow to him heading into to free agency. His dynasty value is pretty much rock bottom at this point, but hopefully he can make a comeback and find a team.
recent_news.title: Calvin Austin III (knee) out for the season with torn ACL

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: The Jets waived Cade York.
recent_news.impact: York will figure to seek another opportunity at some point before or during the season.
recent_news.title: Cade York waived by Jets

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: Kenneth Walker III is not practicing on Tuesday due to a foot injury.
recent_news.impact: It is unclear how serious the injury is for Walker. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
recent_news.title: Kenneth Walker III (foot) not practicing Tuesday

recent_news.author: Leo Sells
recent_news.description: Parker Washington (undisclosed) is participating in Jacksonville's practice on Tuesday.
recent_news.impact: Washington has been battling an undisclosed injury of some kind for a little while now, but he was back and participating at practice on Tuesday. That's a good sign that he is close to full health, especially considering that it was a joint practice with the Buccaneers. He seems to be fully on track to play in Week 1 and remains an intriguing late-round dart throw if healthy.
recent_news.title: Parker Washington (undisclosed) participating in practice Tuesday

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: The Patriots are sending WR Kayshon Boutte to the Texans in exchange for safety Jaylen Reed and a 2028 seventh-round pick.
recent_news.impact: Boutte has had his name in trade rumors for most of the offseason following the Patriots offseason additions of AJ Brown and Romeo Doubs. Boutte will get a fresh start in a wide open wide receiver room with Houston. He should compete for a role as a field stretcher for the Texans.
recent_news.title: Kayshon Boutte traded to Texans

recent_news.author: Nate Miller
recent_news.description: Cedric Tillman was released by the Browns on Thursday.
recent_news.impact: A third-round pick back in 2023, Tillman has failed to really do much of note for the Browns' offense over the last three seasons. The former University of Tennessee standout will now look to catch on with a different team.
recent_news.title: Cedric Tillman released by Browns

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: Tucker Kraft will participate in 11-on-11 drills in the Packers joint practice with Cardinals.
recent_news.impact: Kraft returned to team drills earlier in August. He remains on track to be good to go for Week 1 in September.
recent_news.title: Tucker Kraft (knee) to participate in 11-on-11 drills in joint practice

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: Josh Downs did not practice on Wednesday.
recent_news.impact: Downs missed practice for undisclosed reasons on Tuesday and it is now said to be a calf injury. He remains day-to-day.
recent_news.title: Josh Downs (calf) not practicing Wednesday

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: Zay Flowers did not practice on Wednesday.
recent_news.impact: Flowers remained sidelined after also not practicing on Monday. Wacker notes that he appeared to tweak his ankle last week.
recent_news.title: Zay Flowers misses practice Wednesday

recent_news.author: Diego Sandoval
recent_news.description: Sam Laporta returned to practice on Tuesday after suffering a hip injury last week.
recent_news.impact: Laporta's hip injury has made his status for Week 1 murky, but his returning to practice this early is a good sign. The tight end will likely be limited as he builds back up, but he could be in line to start the season barring any setbacks.
recent_news.title: Sam LaPorta (hip) returns to practice Tuesday

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: The Panthers starters will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the Texans.

recent_news.impact: Nabers was able to practice on Monday without the red non-contact jersey. Barring a setback, he is trending towards being ready for the start of the season.
recent_news.title: Malik Nabers (knee) could be ready for Week 1

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: Vikings WR Jeshaun Jones has been suspended three games.
recent_news.impact: Jones will be eligible to be active in Week 4.
recent_news.title: Jeshaun Jones suspended three games

recent_news.author: Leo Sells
recent_news.description: Jalen McMillan (knee) was not seen practicing for the Buccaneers on Tuesday.
recent_news.impact: McMillan is still battling a knee issue of some kind and was not seen practicing for the Buccaneers on Tuesday. He could be in line for more work at practice if Emeka Egbuka (toe) remains sidelined for the foreseeable future.
recent_news.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) not seen practicing Tuesday

recent_news.author: Garrett Ball
recent_news.description: Ben Sinnott (oblique) is dealing with an oblique injury, per HC Dan Quinn.
recent_news.impact: The third year tight end is primarily a depth option at this point with little fantasy value. That's not to say he hasn't shown potential, he just needs to be given the role. It doesn't seem like that's coming anytime soon though.
recent_news.title: Ben Sinnott (oblique) dealing with oblique injury

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow

recent_news.title: Michael Penix Jr. will not play Friday

recent_news.author: Diego Sandoval
recent_news.description: Trey Benson cleared waivers on Tuesday and will now return to Arizona's injured reserve list.
recent_news.impact: Benson suffered a torn meniscus last season, and it flared up early in training camp this summer. The running back will remain on the injured reserve for the Cardinals, who have a plethora of running backs in Jeremiyah Love, Tyler Allgeier and James Conner.
recent_news.title: Trey Benson clears waivers, returns to Cardinals

recent_news.author: Nate Miller
recent_news.description: Ashton Jeanty is dealing with a lower ankle sprain and his status for Week 1 is uncertain.
recent_news.impact: This is actually a positive development for Jeanty, as there was certainly some concern over a longer-term injury when the second-year running back went down this past Sunday. This could certainly drop Jeanty down some fantasy draft boards a bit, but he should be rolling at full strength by the second or third week of the season at the latest.
recent_news.title: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) uncertain for Week 1

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: Tyler Warren did not practice on Wednesday.
recent_news.impact: Warren remains likely to miss practice all of this week as he recovers from a groin injury. His status for Week 1 is not in danger yet if he can return to practice by next week.
recent_news.title: Tyler Warren (groin) not practicing Wednesday

recent_news.author: Leo Sells
recent_news.description: Emeka Egbuka (toe) is not taking part in Tampa Bay's practice on Tuesday.
recent_news.impact: Tampa Bay was missing their star wideout at practice on Tuesday. He's still recovering from a toe injury, and it remains unclear how much more time he will miss because of it. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on his status to ensure that he'll be ready to play in time for Week 1.
recent_news.title: Emeka Egbuka (toe) not practicing Tuesday

recent_news.author: Leo Sells
recent_news.description: Tez Johnson (groin) is participating at Tampa Bay's practice on Tuesday.
recent_news.impact: The young wideout was able to participate in Tuesday's practice after missing some time due to a groin injury that he suffered earlier this month. He will play a bigger role for the Buccaneers if Emeka Egbuka (toe) or Jalen McMillan (knee) have to miss any time due to their injuries.
recent_news.title: Tez Johnson (groin) participating at practice Tuesday

recent_news.author: Garrett Ball
recent_news.description: Jacorey Croskey-Merritt is dealing with a lower body injury, per HC Dan Quinn.
recent_news.impact: The running back was limited in practice on Monday with an undisclosed injury, and now we at least get clarification of a lower body injury. Which frankly is still a little vague. Fantasy managers will need to wait for more details on the exact extent of his injury, but if he's at least limited, it doesn't sound like it's anything too major.
recent_news.title: Jacorey Croskey-Merritt dealing with lower body injury

recent_news.author: Diego Sandoval
recent_news.description: TreVeyon Henderson is expected to be "good to go" for Week 1 as he continues to recover from an ankle injury.
recent_news.impact: Henderson has missed practice this week and did not travel with the team to their final preseason game, but it seems to be a precautionary measure. The running back seems to be behind veteran Rhamondre Stevenson in the New England depth chart, but he could earn more playing time as the season goes on if he is healthy.

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: Luther Burden III returned to practicing on Wednesday.
recent_news.impact: Burden was back on the field for the first time since injuring his groin on August 8. He went through individual drills and went inside when 7 on 7 started. This should put him on track to be good to go for Week 1.
recent_news.title: Luther Burden III (groin) back at practice Wednesday

recent_news.author: Ari Koslow
recent_news.description: Quinshon Judkins returned to team drills during practice on Tuesday.

recent_news.author: Garrett Ball
recent_news.description: Makai Lemon (hamstring) is back to practicing fully for the first time in weeks. He returned to practice in a limited fashion last week, and is now practicing in full.
recent_news.impact: This is huge for Lemon's development and integration into the offense. The more reps he gets, especially as a rookie, the better. He's looking like a potential draft steal if he can continue to stay healthy and improve his game.
recent_news.title: Makai Lemon (hamstring) practicing in full on Monday

news.impact: Conner's role in the Cardinals backfield remains unclear following the offseason additions of Jeremiyah Love and Tyler Allgeier.
news.title: James Conner (foot) progressing, uncertain for Week 1

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: Deshaun Watson and the Browns starters will not play in Thursday's preseason finale against the Patriots.
news.impact: We will see Watson and the starters for Cleveland back on the field in Week 1 against the Jaguars.
news.title: Deshaun Watson, starters will not play Thursday

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: The Panthers starters will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the Texans.
news.impact: We will see Young and the starters for Carolina back on the field in Week 1 against the Bears.
news.title: Bryce Young, Panthers starters will not play Friday

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: Darnell Wright returned to practice on Wednesday.
news.impact: Wright avoids a scare following his early exit from practice on Tuesday.
news.title: Darnell Wright (elbow) practices Wednesday

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: Luther Burden III returned to practicing on Wednesday.
news.impact: Burden was back on the field for the first time since injuring his groin on August 8. He went through individual drills and went inside when 7 on 7 started. This should put him on track to be good to go for Week 1.
news.title: Luther Burden III (groin) back at practice Wednesday

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: Michael Penix Jr. will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the Dolphins.
news.impact: Penix was cleared for team drills last weekend. Tua Tagovailoa will start on Friday. The starting job for Atlanta in Week 1 remains up in the air.
news.title: Michael Penix Jr. will not play Friday

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: Tua Tagovailoa will start Friday's preseason game against the Dolphins.
news.impact: Tagovailoa will close out the preseason against his former team. Michael Penix Jr. will not play. The starter role for Week 1 remains up in the air.
news.title: Tua Tagovailoa to start preseason finale Friday

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: Ja'Marr Chase is not practicing on Wednesday.
news.impact: Chase appeared to have avoided a scary injury during Tuesday's practice. He was not wearing any protective equipment on the knee, which is notable.
news.title: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) not practicing Wednesday

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: Zay Flowers did not practice on Wednesday.
news.impact: Flowers remained sidelined after also not practicing on Monday. Wacker notes that he appeared to tweak his ankle last week.
news.title: Zay Flowers misses practice Wednesday

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: Bucs first-round pick Reuben Bain Jr. suffered an AC sprain, but he is expected to be ready for Week 1.
news.impact: It is said to be "nothing serious." Bain will still be worth monitoring over the next couple of weeks.
news.title: Rueben Bain Jr. suffers AC sprain, expected to be ready for Week 1

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.description: Calvin Austin III (knee) is out for the season with a torn ACL that he suffered during Tuesday's practice.
news.impact: Austin was trying to find his way onto the field in a crowded Giants receiver room, and now finds himself out for the season. He was in a contract year, so this is a big blow to him heading into to free agency. His dynasty value is pretty much rock bottom at this point, but hopefully he can make a comeback and find a team.
news.title: Calvin Austin III (knee) out for the season with torn ACL

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: Quinshon Judkins returned to team drills during practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Judkins missed two practices last week and was limited to individual work on Monday. He was back full-go on Tuesday.
news.title: Quinshon Judkins returns to team drills

news.author: Diego Sandoval
news.description: Trey Benson cleared waivers on Tuesday and will now return to Arizona's injured reserve list.
news.impact: Benson suffered a torn meniscus last season, and it flared up early in training camp this summer. The running back will remain on the injured reserve for the Cardinals, who have a plethora of running backs in Jeremiyah Love, Tyler Allgeier and James Conner.
news.title: Trey Benson clears waivers, returns to Cardinals

news.author: Diego Sandoval
news.description: D.J. Humphries signed a 1-year deal with the Washington Commanders on Tuesday.
news.impact: Humphries will bring a strong veteran presence to the Washington offensive line, which just lost Laremy Tunsil for the majority, if not all, of the 2026 season. Humphries appeared in eight games for the Rams last season and was last a full-time starter with the Cardinals in 2023.
news.title: D.J. Humphries signs with Commanders

news.author: Leo Sells
news.description: Justin Herbert and most of Los Angeles' starters will play in Thursday's preseason finale against the Los Angeles Rams.
news.impact: HC Jim Harbaugh told reporters that Herbert and most of the team's starters are going to play in their final preseason game on Thursday night, with the exception of a few veterans. It remains unlikely that the starting unit will see more than a quarter or two of action, however.
news.title: Justin Herbert, starters will play Thursday

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.description: Chris Olave was slow to get up after doing a deep route in practice, landing hard on his back. HC Kellen Moore said that the receiver had the wind knocked out of him, and when asked if there would be further tests or cause for concern, declined to answer.
news.impact: It sounds like Olave should be fine. He shouldn't suffer any setbacks because of this unless the staff is hiding details. Draft Olave with confidence as the WR1 in an up and coming Saints offense.
news.title: Chris Olave slow to get up Tuesday at practice

news.author: Diego Sandoval
news.description: Sam Laporta returned to practice on Tuesday after suffering a hip injury last week.
news.impact: Laporta's hip injury has made his status for Week 1 murky, but his returning to practice this early is a good sign. The tight end will likely be limited as he builds back up, but he could be in line to start the season barring any setbacks.
news.title: Sam LaPorta (hip) returns to practice Tuesday

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: Edge rusher Tyus Bowser is working out on Tuesday for the Houston Texans.
news.impact: Bowser last appeared in nine games for the Seahawks and Dolphins in 2024.
news.title: Tyus Bowser works out for Texans

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: The Cardinals signed C Hjalte Froholdt to a two-year, $20 million contract extension.
news.impact: Froholdt has been a full-time starter with Arizona since 2023. He remains a staple of the offensive line for the Cardinals.
news.title: Hjalte Froholdt signs two-year extension with Cardinals

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: Free agent RB Kareem Hunt visited the Lions on Tuesday.
news.impact: Hunt would figure to compete with Isiah Pacheco for the backup role behind Jahmyr Gibbs if he signs with Detroit.
news.title: Kareem Hunt visits Lions

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: Kenneth Walker III is not practicing on Tuesday due to a foot injury.
news.impact: It is unclear how serious the injury is for Walker. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
news.title: Kenneth Walker III (foot) not practicing Tuesday

news.author: Leo Sells
news.description: Ty Johnson (leg) didn't practice on Tuesday but has resumed running.
news.impact: Johnson was technically a non-participant at Buffalo's practice on Tuesday, but he seems to be progressing well with his recovery and has resumed running. The team isn't certain whether or not he will be ready for Week 1 at this point, but his status doesn't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes.
news.title: Ty Johnson (leg) progressing with recovery

news.author: Leo Sells
news.description: Parker Washington (undisclosed) is participating in Jacksonville's practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Washington has been battling an undisclosed injury of some kind for a little while now, but he was back and participating at practice on Tuesday. That's a good sign that he is close to full health, especially considering that it was a joint practice with the Buccaneers. He seems to be fully on track to play in Week 1 and remains an intriguing late-round dart throw if healthy.
news.title: Parker Washington (undisclosed) participating in practice Tuesday

news.author: Leo Sells
news.description: Emeka Egbuka (toe) is not taking part in Tampa Bay's practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Tampa Bay was missing their star wideout at practice on Tuesday. He's still recovering from a toe injury, and it remains unclear how much more time he will miss because of it. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on his status to ensure that he'll be ready to play in time for Week 1.
news.title: Emeka Egbuka (toe) not practicing Tuesday

news.author: Leo Sells
news.description: Tez Johnson (groin) is participating at Tampa Bay's practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: The young wideout was able to participate in Tuesday's practice after missing some time due to a groin injury that he suffered earlier this month. He will play a bigger role for the Buccaneers if Emeka Egbuka (toe) or Jalen McMillan (knee) have to miss any time due to their injuries.
news.title: Tez Johnson (groin) participating at practice Tuesday

news.author: Leo Sells
news.description: Jalen McMillan (knee) was not seen practicing for the Buccaneers on Tuesday.
news.impact: McMillan is still battling a knee issue of some kind and was not seen practicing for the Buccaneers on Tuesday. He could be in line for more work at practice if Emeka Egbuka (toe) remains sidelined for the foreseeable future.
news.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) not seen practicing Tuesday

news.author: Leo Sells
news.description: Josh Allen won't play in Thursday night's preseason finale against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.impact: Allen saw some action earlier on in the preseason, but he is set to be sidelined for the team's final preseason game on Thursday night. He is fully healthy at this point and looks primed for another huge season from a fantasy perspective.
news.title: Josh Allen won't play Thursday

news.author: Nate Miller
news.description: Ashton Jeanty is dealing with a lower ankle sprain and his status for Week 1 is uncertain.
news.impact: This is actually a positive development for Jeanty, as there was certainly some concern over a longer-term injury when the second-year running back went down this past Sunday. This could certainly drop Jeanty down some fantasy draft boards a bit, but he should be rolling at full strength by the second or third week of the season at the latest.
news.title: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) uncertain for Week 1

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.description: Ben Sinnott (oblique) is dealing with an oblique injury, per HC Dan Quinn.
news.impact: The third year tight end is primarily a depth option at this point with little fantasy value. That's not to say he hasn't shown potential, he just needs to be given the role. It doesn't seem like that's coming anytime soon though.
news.title: Ben Sinnott (oblique) dealing with oblique injury

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.description: Jacorey Croskey-Merritt is dealing with a lower body injury, per HC Dan Quinn.
news.impact: The running back was limited in practice on Monday with an undisclosed injury, and now we at least get clarification of a lower body injury. Which frankly is still a little vague. Fantasy managers will need to wait for more details on the exact extent of his injury, but if he's at least limited, it doesn't sound like it's anything too major.
news.title: Jacorey Croskey-Merritt dealing with lower body injury

news.author: Nate Miller
news.description: Dylan Horton will miss the entirety of the 2026 season due to a torn Achilles.
news.impact: Tests confirmed the severity of Horton's injury on Monday. The fourth-year defensive end played in 16 games for the Texans last season, recording 26 tackles, 0.5 sacks, and one forced fumble.
news.title: Dylan Horton (Achilles) to miss the 2026 season

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said "it's reasonable to assume" that Malik Nabers is trending toward being ready for Week 1.
news.impact: Nabers was able to practice on Monday without the red non-contact jersey. Barring a setback, he is trending towards being ready for the start of the season.
news.title: Malik Nabers (knee) could be ready for Week 1

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: The Patriots are sending WR Kayshon Boutte to the Texans in exchange for safety Jaylen Reed and a 2028 seventh-round pick.
news.impact: Boutte has had his name in trade rumors for most of the offseason following the Patriots offseason additions of AJ Brown and Romeo Doubs. Boutte will get a fresh start in a wide open wide receiver room with Houston. He should compete for a role as a field stretcher for the Texans.
news.title: Kayshon Boutte traded to Texans

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.description: Makai Lemon (hamstring) is back to practicing fully for the first time in weeks. He returned to practice in a limited fashion last week, and is now practicing in full.
news.impact: This is huge for Lemon's development and integration into the offense. The more reps he gets, especially as a rookie, the better. He's looking like a potential draft steal if he can continue to stay healthy and improve his game.
news.title: Makai Lemon (hamstring) practicing in full on Monday

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.description: Devonta Smith (hamstring) is practicing fully on Monday for the first time in three weeks. He returned in a limited fashion recently, but he is back to fully participating.
news.impact: It's great news for Smith as he works his way back from a hamstring injury. This should be the all the confidence boost fantasy managers needed to continue targeting him highly in drafts.
news.title: DeVonta Smith practicing fully on Monday

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.description: The Saints signed K Daniel Carlson.
news.impact: Carlson will compete with Tanner Brown and Charlie Smyth for the starting kicker job for New Orleans.
news.title: Daniel Carlson signs with Saints

news.author: Diego Sandoval
news.description: Zamir White was traded to the New Orleans Saints on Sunday in exchange for Deion Jones.
news.impact: White is now heading to New Orleans after being picked up by the 49ers this offseason. The 26-year-old is likely being brought in as a depth piece behind Travis Etienne Jr. following the injury to Alvin Kamara, who is expected to be sidelined for a month with a sprained MCL.
news.title: Zamir White traded to Saints
